besluite.fout: The paragraph names the team 'die Springbokke', switches to 'Suid-Afrika' for one sentence and then uses 'hulle', so a Grade 4 reader meets a second name for the same team mid-sequence.
besluite.rede: Keeping 'hulle' continues the subject of the previous sentence (die Springbokke), so the reference is clearer and the people, matches and outcome stay exactly the same.

With 'na' the team travels to the cities with the cup; with 'deur' it travels through them, so the preposition changes the account of a real event, and 'na groot stede' with a plural already reads naturally.
